Chat request to Anthropic provider with a tool definition; assistant responds with a tool call

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"max_tokens\":256,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather in London?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\",\"tool_choice\":\"auto\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city and country, e.g. London, UK\",\"type\":\"string\"},\"unit\":{\"description\":\"The temperature unit to use\",\"enum\":[\"celsius\",\"fahrenheit\"],\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val apiKey = requireNotNull(System.getenv("API_KEY")) { "API_KEY must be set" }
    val result = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey = apiKey).use { client -> client.chat(req) }
    println(result.choices)
    println(result.choices.first().message.toolCalls)
    println(result.choices.first().message.toolCalls?.first()?.function?.name)
    println(result.choices.first().finishReason)
}
```
